nodes.title: Original character / outfit reference - used by ALL views
Note: Qwen Image 2.1 character sheet
widgets_values:
# Muse Character Sheet — Qwen Image 2.1

Qwen Image 2.1 port of **Muse Character Sheet (Klein)**. Same node UI: a 5-pose turnaround (portrait, front, left profile, right profile, back) from **one character reference photo**, with **Confirm** / **New seed** / **Apply edit** per pose, **Edit all poses**, and **Build final sheet now** (4096x2304 by default).

What changed from Klein:
- The Qwen3-VL text encoder **sees** the reference photo (image 1), and it is also spliced in as a latent (`TextEncodeQwenImage21`, ComfyUI core).
- A real **negative prompt** (a widget), active because cfg is 4.
- **40 steps, cfg 4**, euler/simple. Qwen 2.1 is not step-distilled, so expect about 10x Klein's time per pose.
- The optional mannequin sheet (bypassed loader, top) is cropped per pose and passed as **image 2**, with a prompt line saying it is a pose guide only.
- `cache_device` / `cache_dtype` drive `QwenImage21Cache`; leave them on auto/default unless you're VRAM-starved (then try dtype int8).

## Required
- Node pack: [qwen_image_2.1_character_sheet](https://github.com/fastlaneracing/qwen_image_2.1_character_sheet).
- [ComfyUI-RMBG](https://github.com/1038lab/ComfyUI-RMBG) for the white-background cleanup.
- Impact Pack + Subpack only if you turn Face Detail on.

## Models ([Comfy-Org/Qwen-Image-2.1](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Qwen-Image-2.1))
- `diffusion_models/qwen_image_2.1_bf16.safetensors` (or `qwen_image_2.1_int8_convrot`)
- `text_encoders/qwen3vl_8b_bf16.safetensors` (or `qwen3vl_8b_int8_convrot`)
- `vae/qwen_image_2.1_vae_bf16.safetensors`
